newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police arrest suspected ETA member.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police arrest suspected ETA member.

text.p: Spanish police arrested a suspected ETA Basque separatist on Wednesday at Madrid's Barajas airport, an Interior Ministry spokesman said.
Francisco Javier Gomez Montes, also known as "Chalaparta", was arrested while waiting for a flight to Uruguay.
Interior Ministry spokesman Cayetano Gonzalez told local radio that the arrest was not thought to be linked to the murder of an army officer in Madrid earlier on Wednesday.
"Chalaparta" is suspected of involvement in the murder of a tobacconist in Bilbao in 1980.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed some 800 people since launching its campaign for independence from Spain in 1968.
